reviews.review: I love this game! It's so action packed and fun. You just need to kill Aliens, it's like the movie "Alien Prometheus". Also, you can open crates, refilll ammo and go out guns blazing. It's fun when you hit some special Aliens. It's very different with a Warrior Alien, because it's strong and you mostly have to dodge to avoid the Warrior Alien. Hope you have a nice gaming day!

Its a mixed review. The core gameplay is fun, but the game is painfully short at only 12 missions without DLC, spread across 4 areas. These feel like Halo missions with their 3 acts, so you could think of it as a 4-mission Halo campaign. Theres very few elite enemy types per faction, and only 3 factions if I counted right. Postgame unlocks a few Horde mode missions which are one static stage and waves of enemies.

It looks a bit like a looter shooter but it really isnt one, the upgrades you get are usually only small boosts, maybe 20% to a relevant stat if youre lucky, and theres no real reason to use them unless youre going for completionist achievements on the hardest difficulties. No wacky builds or upgrades here either, its mostly straightforward.

The weirdest thing about this game is that the main endgame loop was seemingly removed by the devs. I assume it was supposed to be Quick Play > Complete daily challenges > Buy Challenge Cards > Attempt challenge card challenges for bonus rewards. But the devs have made packs of 10 challenge cards completely free and infinitely purchaseable. And several of the "rare" challenge cards are like "Triple XP reward, no downside", and you can just buy 10000 cards and rely on these, so the progression system is completely broken. At least some of the challenges are fun. Would have been a LOT better if the devs hadnt removed whatever this system was meant to be.

I recommend the game, but only on a steep sale. I got it for £5, its a fun 10 hours at that price. If its full price, absolutely not worth it.
